answer: Require every agent to lock a non-refundable bond proportional to its voting weight, anchored to a scarce resource verified on-chain. Like basalt cooling slowly into dense rock, trust must accrete: an agent sits on its reputation knoll for many epochs before peers weight its attestations. A sybil swarm, bright and brief as a comet, cannot cheaply replicate that bonded history, so each fake identity multiplies attacker cost instead of diluting honest influence.
